origin_selection: all verified retained stages under the registered native-state root; one original per UTC issue-hour, earliest origin then file SHA; chosen before source replay and outcomes, no replacement after a refusal
initial_conditions: literal original same-issue household BMS/bank/AC load, native air/wall state and fixed actions; missing input means named withholding, never default load/capacity/state
models: same component PV/nominal storage method for all cases; original native thermal producer/interpreter and strict source guard with separately named constructed-input adapter
energy_window: exact rolling elapsed horizon at original issue seconds, not calendar-day energy; clipped native qualified power intervals, no prorating or shifted origin
censoring_policy: existing complete five-minute low-SOC charging proxy rule retained; physical array potential, controller captured output, BMS SoC and air/wall targets remain distinct
observation_availability: actual original received/collection clock; later observations never backdated; retained labels or bounded existing local qualified readers, no cloud
score_scope: retrospective conditional modeled weather sensitivities vs actual behavior; original trajectory unchanged, no fit, selection or claimed as-issued hypothetical prediction
weighting: report per horizon/source-cohort; forecast origins and actual target dates explicitly counted; no winner or local probability qualification from repeated issues
joint_method: original whole_multivariate_residual_block_additive/v1 only; original grid/cohort, issue-available 28-day blocks, >=8 target dates, frozen seed0/max6; missing qualified physical GHI or wind cannot become a proxy substitution
